rv.q: ERNEST SHACKLETON LOVES ME has a truly original concept, even if the plotting doesn't always match the originality of said concept (the ending, in particular, is too tidy).
Together they make this 90-minute production of love and adventure a spectacular evening you wish could continue forever.
This is a technically complicated production, perfectly realized by director Michael Unger and Music Director Eric Svejcar.
“Ernest Shackleton Loves Me” is an efficient, ninety-minute adventure that will leave you believing that you, too, can surmount life’s obstacles.
“Ernest Shackleton ” is a playful romp, pushing the envelope of musical stylings and overflowing with talent.
ERNEST SHACKLETON LOVES ME is a swirl of contemporary and history.
You will leave the theater with a tremendous smile on your face and a warm feeling in your heart.

cn.t: This quirky, charming two-hander about a struggling single mother and the Antarctic explorer wins critics over with its imaginative premise, sparkling humor, and offbeat beauty, though its unconventional pairing proves more delightful than dramatically deep.
